title: Resend button
description: A 12px-radius button: primary is a dark graphite gradient with a faint hairline that turns near-white with black ink and a soft white glow on hover; ghost is grey text that brightens. An optional chevron nudges right on hover.
notes: hover glow uses the theme's glow colour; 0.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) like the original
name: resend-button
